note: Post-call extraction. Every field is nullable and every value is untrusted: lib/calls/parse.ts reads it, lib/switch/quotes.ts decides whether it is believable.

fuel.name: price_per_gal
fuel.description: The cash or COD price per gallon the dealer said today. If they only gave a card price, leave null and record the surcharge.

fuel.name: card_surcharge_pct
fuel.description: Card surcharge in percent, e.g. 2.5 for 'two and a half percent'. Null when they charge the same either way.

fuel.name: min_gallons
fuel.description: Minimum delivery in gallons. Null when the dealer named no minimum.

fuel.name: delivery_fee
fuel.description: Delivery or small-load fee in dollars at the household's delivery size. Null when there is none.

fuel.name: price_cap_per_gal
fuel.description: Prebuy or price-cap price per gallon for the winter. Null when not offered. Never a substitute for the cash price.

fuel.name: price_cap_fee
fuel.description: The fee for the prebuy or cap, in dollars. Null when not offered.

fuel.name: earliest_delivery
fuel.description: Earliest delivery date as YYYY-MM-DD. Convert 'Tuesday' only when the date is unambiguous; otherwise leave null.

fuel.name: serves_town
fuel.description: Whether the dealer says they deliver to the homeowner's town.

fuel.name: needs_callback
fuel.description: True when the dealer asked to call the homeowner back instead of quoting. The homeowner is told to call them.

installer.name: mass_save_participating
installer.description: Whether the installer says they are on the Mass Save participating contractor list.

installer.name: accepts_heat_loan
installer.description: Whether the installer accepts the 0% HEAT Loan.

installer.name: earliest_site_visit
installer.description: Earliest site visit date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null when they would not commit to one.

installer.name: can_install_by_dec31
installer.description: Whether they say they can finish an install by 2026-12-31.

installer.name: ballpark_per_ton
installer.description: Installed cost per ton in dollars, as a ballpark. Never a quote: the screen labels it as one.

installer.name: needs_callback
installer.description: True when they asked to call the homeowner back instead of answering.
